# Agent Skills Index

Copilot can load task-specific skills from the directories in this folder.

| Skill | Use for |
|---|---|
| `project-architecture` | Architecture and cross-cutting changes |
| `wedding-ui-design` | Visual direction, layouts and design system |
| `react-frontend` | React components, hooks and browser behaviour |
| `vercel-serverless` | Vercel Function endpoints and server-side operations |
| `mongodb-data` | MongoDB schemas, indexes and persistence |
| `rsvp-management` | Family/group RSVP business rules |
| `google-sheets-sync` | One-way write-through reporting mirror |
| `guestbook-interactions` | Guestbook (named public, anonymous private) |
| `quality-assurance` | Tests, accessibility, security and release checks |

Each `SKILL.md` has a short description for discovery. Detailed references are kept beside the skill and should be loaded only when relevant.
